SPELL_ABILITY.TARGET_DEFINITION: local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE )
SPELL_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then local characteristics = target:GetCurrentCharacteristics() local power = characteristics:Power_Get() EffectDC():Set_Int( 2, power ) end
SPELL_ABILITY.CONTINUOUS_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) local number = EffectDC():Get_Int(2) if target ~= nil then local characterisitics = target:GetCurrentCharacteristics() characterisitics:Power_Add( number ) end
